en: “Hello there!”
“Eh—is that {Me}?”
“Um... Yeah.”
“Hehe... So, you're into nuns?”
“A l-little? I thought I'd give this a try.”
“Is something bothering you?”
“Not exactly... it's just... um...”
“Maybe I should go back?”
“Wait a minute—Why would you say that?”
“Now that I think about it, I'm a bit embarrassed.”
“Alright, alright. Just sit down and relax, we're just chatting!”
“Otherwise, I'll be talking with all those old hags all day. See it as you keeping me company, kay?”
“Oh, if you put it like that...”
“Actually, to be honest... I have something I want to confess to you...”
“Hey... Are you doing this on purpose?”
“You know I was looking for you. But you were ignoring me.”
“And now you come here to spend some alone time with me?”
“Ayano...”
“Do you want to... you know.”
“...Yeah.”
“Here? Um...”
“Well, no one will see us~”
Ayano opens up the little slot.
I see her wet tongue squirming about.
“I'm so turned on.”
“Let Sister Ayano take care of you~”
“Hmph! You're bullying me on purpose!”
“You know I want to, but you're ignoring me...”
“You only want to when we're here.”
The curtain gets pulled open again.
But now what I see isn't the mouth... it's a wet vagina.
It looks like she's been rubbing it for quite some time. It's so wet that it's dripping.
“So naughty...”
“I've been waiting for so long.”
“This time... you're going to pleasure me.”
